title: Arms Outstretched Warrior
description: A young East Asian man with dark hair stands centered against a dark textured background with arms fully outstretched to the sides. He wears a detailed dark gray and black fantasy coat with blue inner lining, cropped top, pants with straps, and boots, with a long sword sheathed at his left hip.
prompt: A young East Asian man with dark purple-tinted hair standing frontally with arms stretched straight out to the sides, wearing a long dark gray fantasy coat with blue lining, cropped black top, multiple buckles and straps, fingerless gloves, and tall boots. A long katana-style sword is sheathed at his hip. Dramatic lighting, dark textured background with faint construction lines, cinematic character art, digital painting style.
